subject: Rebaseline: ACME POC scope and success criteria
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priya@acmecorp.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up / success criteria

Thanks Marissa — good call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can lock the kickoff timeline: 

- Priority use case: intelligent document routing (incoming support tickets -> auto-classify + route to queue).
- Secondary use case we'd like to try if time allows: agent-assist snippets inside CRM.
- Success criteria we discussed: 80% routing accuracy on >10k historical tickets, median inference latency < 300ms for single-message requests, and clear audit logs for matched rules.

As we prep infra, can you confirm what you need from our side for network + data access? Also attaching our initial success criteria spreadsheet for reference.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up / success criteria

Samir — thanks for the clear recap and the spreadsheet. Appreciate Priya joining as well. A few notes and proposed next steps: 

1) Scope baseline: we can commit to the routing use case as the primary POC and the agent-assist as an optional expansion if we hit the baseline early.
2) Success criteria: the three metrics you suggested look reasonable. For latency, can you confirm average ticket size (text length)? That affects batching/throughput profile.
3) Timeline: propose kickoff week of Aug 3, 2-week ingest & validation, then a 3-week evaluation window. We can rebaseline after week 2 if additional use cases are added.
4) Network/data: we will need a read-only S3 export of the historical tickets (redacted PII) + an engineer for initial access. If S3 isn't possible, we can accept an encrypted archive. See attached network_requirements.pdf for firewall egress rules and IP allowlist.

Next steps (action owners):
- Samir: share S3 export or archive + sample ticket sizes (by Jul 30)
- Priya: confirm legal/cols about redaction (by Jul 30)
- Dev Patel (cc): will scope ingestion and confirm required log formats
- Marissa: will send a formal POI + onboarding template and calendar invite for kickoff

If you want to tighten the success criteria (e.g., precision vs recall breakdown) we can capture that in the shared sheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: network_requirements.pdf (PDF stub)

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up / success criteria

Hi Samir — quick technical clarifications so we size the ingest work correctly: 

- Sample sizes: can you share distribution of ticket lengths (median, 75th, 95th percentile)? If many long threads (>2k chars) we will validate KV-cache behaviour and tokenization impact.
- Labels: how consistent are your routing labels? If labels are noisy we recommend adding an initial manual review set of ~1k tickets for evaluation calibration.
- Real-time vs batch: do you expect the POC to demonstrate <300ms for single-message live traffic, or is 300ms a target for our hosted evaluation on your sample set? Live latency requires a dedicated configuration (we can run on Dedicated capacity for a short test).

I'll draft an ingestion checklist today and drop into the shared drive.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

From: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: priya@acmecorp.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up / success criteria

Thanks Dev — answers inline: 

- Ticket lengths: median ~420 characters, 75th ~1.1k, 95th ~2.8k. We will include a sample CSV with percentiles.
- Labels: about ~85% clean mapping, but there is ~15% noise (mislabels and legacy queues). We can carve out a manual review set.
- Live vs sample: the initial evaluation is on a historical sample (sampled for representativeness). Our long-term goal is live <300ms; for the POC please target the sample median latency to be <300ms and include a plan for Dedicated testing if we move to live.

I'll share the S3 export and sample CSV by Friday (Jul 31).

—Samir

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 09:12 AM marissa_cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> Great — that matches our expectations. Once we have the CSV and S3 export Dev will validate ingestion and we can lock the kickoff.
>
> Marissa

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmecorp.com>, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priya@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Rebaseline: ACME POC scope and success criteria

Folks — thanks for the quick responses and for the data promise. One item surfaced during internal review: the CS team asked if we can add a second evaluation axis for "explainability" — specifically, a short provenance trace for each routing decision (top-3 contributing phrases / matched rules) that a reviewer can inspect. This isn't covered in the original success sheet.

Proposed rebaseline (to keep timeline intact):
- Keep primary routing use case and original metrics (accuracy + latency + audit logs).
- Add explainability as a qualitative acceptance criterion: during the 3-week evaluation, we will deliver a small UI that surfaces top-3 rationale snippets for sampled routed tickets. Acceptance: product reviewer confirms rationale is meaningful for a sample of 200 tickets.
- If explainability requires additional instrumentation, Dev will advise on effort during ingestion week. If the extra work pushes the schedule, we will prioritize a parity evaluation (same data) and rebaseline only the optional agent-assist follow-up.

Action items updated:
- Samir: S3 export + sample CSV (by Jul 31)
- Dev: ingestion checklist + estimate for explainability work (by Aug 4)
- Ben: prepare kickoff calendar + invite (week of Aug 3)
- Marissa: update POI and scope doc in shared drive

If that all sounds good I will update the shared success criteria sheet and lock the kickoff for Aug 4 (tentative).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
